nom: VANICREAM Daily Facial Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid and Ceramides

avis.titre: I buy this again and again
avis.texte: the only moisturizer I have bought repeatedly for my sensitive POD skin. Great all year round.
This is the only moisturizer I've used that makes my skin hot and burn. Had to wash it off immediately. If you're sensitive to pentylene glycol, avoid this.

I've repurchased this moisturizer countless times and got my husband using it too! It's best in its simplicity- the ingredient list is shorter than most of my other moisturizers. It has what I need and not what I don't want (like silicones or heavy oils). I have oily acne prone skin and it plays well with my skin and under powder and liquid foundation. It works well in both summer and winter without having to use additional products. I highly recommend if you have sensitive acne prone skin! Please don't change the formula!

I was looking for hydrating face moisturizer for years now and was no happy with other brands finally I tried this product and instantly I knew it was for me I have very dry skin and it keeps me hydrated for long time definitely recommend must buy

avis.titre: Great for sensitive  skin using prescription Retinoids
avis.texte: I have tried dozens of different moisturizers, even even some ranging $300 or more. This is by far the best moisturizer I've ever used. It spreads easily and is hydrating. I appreciate that it has a short simple ingredient list with ceramides and hyaluronic acid. I always keep a spare bottle on hand. I haven't tried it in the winter yet, so I hope it hydrates steering the harsh Minnesota winter
Great moisturizer and not greasy. EWG and Yuka rating are excellent.
I just switched from Cetaphil facial products to Vanicream's and I'm already not a fan. The Vanicream moisturizer seems to have the opposite effect on my skin and leaves it feeling very dry.

avis.titre: I love this product...it's the "non-fragrance" I don't like
avis.texte: LOOK...I love this product...it's the "non-fragrance" I don't like at all! It smells musty or like dirt. Therefore, it takes a lot for me to put this on my face. I will use it til it's done but I will not purchase this again.

this is a great moisturizer! i tried a new acne product back in November and ended up getting a chemical burn all over my face. a friend that works in dermatology recommended i use this to help and it worked wonders for me! i have been using this ever since! it is very light weight and a little goes a long ways! it's also super affordable which is always a plus!

Great for sensitive, acne-prone skin. Bought this as an alternative to my previous moisturizer that was reformulated with niacinimide and caused small blisters and redness on my face. Have had no problems with this!
Got a sample at my derms office. Makes my skin soft, it has a lightweight texture that absorbs nicely and most importantly doesn't irritate my skin. Definitely is helping repair skin barrier.
I love the product, the only issue is that it needs to be sold in a bigger size container.

I read a positive review of this and tried it because Cerave left my skin feeling dry after a few minutes. I was doubtful because it feels so light and thin coming out of the tube, but it moisturizes so well! My skin feels dewy in the morning after putting it on before bed. My only wish is that it camenin a larger container, like a tub with pump.

I wish I had taken a look at the reviews more. This caused tiny bumps all over my face like I have never had before. They are skin colored and itchy. Going back to my CeraVe moisturizer. Only tried this one because I like their body wash.
This is exactly what I needed. Lightweight for the day but yet hydrating enough to not make me feel like I'm cracking throughout the day.
Good find because it works for all types of skin, making it soft and hydrated. Non comedogenic. The price is spot in as well.

I tried this at the recommendation of my dermatologist because I have eczema and rosacea. It just ended up giving me cystic acne, which I have never had before. The formula seems lightweight when you're touching it, but for some reason it just sat on top of my skin, and never really absorbed. Back to the search I go.

My skin has been freaking out with this weird weather, and none of my products were helping. I ordered some KBeauty skincare from YesStyle, but it was taking too long, so I decided to try Vanicream. My skin was peeling and SUPER itchy. After washing and using the moisturizer, I noticed a difference right away. DEF is worth a shot if you're experiencing something similar. The moisturizer is very nourishing and helped get rid of my itchy and dry/peeling skin. I'm happy not to have to scratch my face!

My ride of die. I have prpbably been through 12-15 of these, it is the perfect moisturizer for my dry, acne prone skin. So hydrating, and simple. now when i try to use any other moisturizer (even really expensive ones) my skin feels so dry i immediately switch back

This moisturizer is absolutely perfect for everyday use, in pretty much all climates/ seasons. It is lightweight, yet feels nourishing and hydrating. It goes on almost like a gel/ cream texture and spreads easily over the face. The best aspect for me is that it doesn't burn or sting my super sensitive skin at all! The price is a plus too. All around it's a great deal, and a great basic moisturizer that does what it claims.
This is a great moisturizer! Why is Ulta charging $5 more than the average retailer?

Love this moisturizer! I stuggle with hormonal acne and wish I wouldve found this face lotion sooner. Usually moisturizers feel heavy on my face however this lotion is light and hydrating!! Recommend! Ive put my friends and family on this lotion and they also enjoy this product!

This moisturizer is a great, lightweight, everyday moisturizer for my sensitive, combination skin. Would recommend for this purpose. With this being said, though, if a heavier moisturizer is needed, I would recommend a different product.

This product worked just okay for me. I have dry skin and prefer moisturizers that feel dewy and deeply hydrating, and this one doesn't quite deliver that. It does provide hydration, but it has more of a traditional lotion feel to it and I hate the feeling. I've been using it at night instead of during the day so I can pair it with my azelaic acid and Arazlo. During the day, I stick with Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream — she's that girl, just pricey.

I have used moisturizers at all price points and this is the one I would repurchase time and again regardless of what they're charging. It has a milky texture that is lightweight enough not to flare my rosacea but moisturizing enough to nourish my dry skin. Once absorbed, it's non-sticky with a satin finish. It layers beautifully with other skincare as well as under makeup and spf. Plus you get so much product for such a reasonable price. Love this stuff.

I bought this because I needed a moisturizer and I was kind of disappointed. My skin needs some extra hydration between the colder months and aging. This is not hydrating at all and made my skin kind of dull looking, especially after waking up. It also seemed to give me a few breakouts. I decided to continue using it anyway, and the breakouts ended up going away, so it's possible my skin just needed to get used to it or it just wasn't the culprit; hard to tell. Any way, I think it would be nice for oily skin or summer months. Also, I did see a tip to apply moisturizer with your foundation for a more dewy, natural look, so it's perfect for that
Glad it works for others, it burns each time i put it on and then a few hours later it starts pilling
My go to moisturizer. My skin is so picky, please please PLEASE never change the formula!

avis.titre: Tiny Bumps All Over my Face
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this but after adding it to my routine I noticed tiny bumps all over my face. When I stopped using it the bumps went away. I do have sensitive skin and eczema but this claimed to be safe for both.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again
avis.texte: I have to use products free of fragrance and preservatives, and this is one of the few products I can use. I was pleasantly surprised to find that it's a great moisturizer! I love it and will continue to use it.

Im used to using the vanicream moisturizing cream thays in the pump, but bought this for travel purposes, thinking it would be similar. Like other reviews, this burns and stings every time i put it on, eventually when the stinging goes away it starts to itch. I also started getting mini texture bumps all over my skin. Super disappointing. Wish theyd put the cream in a smaller bottle/tube!
This is my go to when I'm peeling/sunburned/had procedures/too much retinol (as its super calming, hydrating and doesn't burn my sensitive skin. Love how lightweight it is.

avis.titre: just didnt work for my skin
avis.texte: this moisturizer is very hydrating & not overly greasy but it burns my skin (i am prone to eczema around my eyes & nose) and i feel it made my clogged comodones worse.
I love this moisturizer. Doesn't break me out, keeps my face soft and doesn't interfere with my makeup.

avis.titre: Hyaluronic acid, ceramics, and squaline? This is PERFECT
avis.texte: All 4 of us in my house use this. It is WAY better than any other"Moisture Bank" gel of any type. It is completely fragrance free, completely affordable, and so so good for your skin! I will never choose another moisturizer. This is holy grail. I buy 4 avery other month. And I have backups!

avis.titre: Superb hydration and makes my face look great
avis.texte: I've tried many, many moisturizers over decades and this daily facial moisturizer, applied at bedtime, is the only one that leaves my face still soft and moisturized upon waking in the morning. Daytime application leaves my face looking radiant and beautiful (even if it is sun-drenched after a California lifetime) and unburdened by heavy ingredients. It's absolutely perfect.
Simple ingredients, safe for sensitive and acne-prone skin, I would buy this again.

everytime i have used this, it stings/burns really bad. it causes my face to itch really bad too. and it caused me to breakout. it made me get tiny bumps everywhere and just made the texture and appearance of my face terrible. i reallllly wanted to love this, ive tried to love it, but it just does not work for me at all. which really sucks because its supposed to be good for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: I've never written a product review before
avis.texte: This moisturizer is awesome! The packaging isn't sexy and it doesn't scream luxury but if you want something that works incredibly well for a great price, this is it. Super lightweight feeling, goes well under my makeup, and moisturizes all day long. I've got problem skin and live in a desert climate so I need serious moisture without clogging pores or irritating ingredients.
I have used this for years and i think it is amazing, my skin is on the drier side so this is not as hydrating for me because it is lightweight but it it's still a good simple moisturizer.

avis.titre: MY STAPLE, PLEASE GIVE US A BIG SIZE WITH PUMP!
avis.texte: Hydrating. Gentle. Amazing. I use it with tretinoin and it's great for both summer and winter. I have gone through so many tubes it's crazy. PLEASE GIVE US THE VALUE SIZE WITH PUMP!
i would only recommend this for dry skin, thats all. if youre combo/oily, dont use it in the day or else you will be greasy. it takes a while to absord into my skin and feels heavy.

I have rosacea and a super oily/acne prone t-zone and just very sensitive skin in general. I've tried a million moisturizers and this is the one I keep coming back to over and over again. It is the only moisturizer I've ever tried that doesn't exacerbate my redness or cause breakouts. I will say it doesn't do great at controlling oil. I layer sunscreen and then a mattifying primer on top of it to control shine.
This product cleared my skin from breakouts and I will be using this from now on. Excellent product with clean ingredients ! Love it
Best moisturizer ever! Works on my face to calm down sensitive skin reactions. I have rosacea and psoriasis. Wonderful product. Hope they never change the formula.

I've always found myself coming back to this moisturizer. It's labeled as ezcema safe, affordable, & has ingredients listed that seem efficient at moisturizing. Never felt heavy, but I feel like it's lacking that hydration I need, especially when I use Azeliac acid and other actives. But what really made me comment was seeing other people experience reddness/stinging/sensitivity. EVERY time I've used this either with an active or without one, I experience the reddness/stinging/sensitivity. I've even used it on damp and dry skin to see if it would improve. Even when I decided to break and come back to this moisture, I still experience the reddness/stinging/sensivity. Sigh, this product isn't for me.

avis.titre: Used to love, can't even use!
avis.texte: I used to love this product, but recently had been having terrible skin. I canceled all sorts of things out of my routine and my diet, and couldn't figure out what it was. This was my last resort because it never bothered me in the past, but sadly, it causes a stinging burning sensation followed by acne. I have never had so many cystic pimples as when I was using this as well as smaller bumps. We'll never use this again, even though there a.m. sunscreen is my holy Grail!

avis.titre: I wanted to love it but sadly, this did not work for me!
avis.texte: I bought this because it's targeted for sensitive skin. I found that I would experience this burning sensation each time I applied. I've used it for 2 months now and I will not be repurchasing. It sucks because the finish is really nice. I wanted something for my sensitive skin but I will have to keep searching.

Tried this out because i have dry skin. I love the way it feels when I apply. However the dewy finish goes away fast. I've been using it for a month and its making my nose peel. Its just not that moisturizing for me. Im glad it seems to work for others, just not a fit for my skin.

I have been looking for a moisturizer that doesn't break me out. After much research, and comparing product ingredients on all of my skincare, I discovered that butylene glycol clogs my pores and gives me a lot of closed comedones on my forehead. This moisturizer has good, clean ingredients that leaves my skin feeling hydrated and soft. It's definitely nothing fancy or trendy but IT WORKS BEAUTIFULLY! Also, for reference: I have combo (oily t-zone and dry cheeks), very reactive, and acne-prone skin. This moisturizer is slightly liquidy, and I would say it feels the TINIEST bit greasy, but it does dry down nicely after a minute with no greasiness, tackiness, or slip.

avis.titre: Amazing no notes love love love
avis.texte: I was introduced to this product from my dermatologist and it is incredible. i started buying it in the store. i have very dry skin and this is the only moisturizer that doesn't make my skin burn when applied. it also keeps my skin hydrated and healthy. i have been getting micro needling done which dries out the skin and this cream has been amazing for irritation and helping to keep some moisture locked in. LOVE IT

This moisturizer feels really nice! The texture is sort of a liquidy cream and feels hydrating without feeling greasy, it absorbs really well and my skin feels so soft and calm after and looks healthy. I have combination skin and i feel pretty balanced everywhere after using this, I've used at night and during the day under makeup and have been happy with the way it performs. Its nice by itself, but has also has gone well with the other products I've used as well, when ive wanted to layer or used exfoliation. I think this would be great for a pretty wide range of skin types and age ranges.

I have extremely sensitive rosacea prone skin. I have tried everything! All the derm recommended products and nothing worked- constantly orritated to the point I couldnt put any lotions or make up on my skin. I randomly pickded this up at the pharmacy and its conpletely changed my skin- healthy, moisturized and calmed down my redness and irritation. So thankful for this moisturizer.
this makes my skin glow! not sure how it'll do in hot weather but if anything it'll be a great night moisturizer. I have acne prone oily skin and no issues with it.

I find it too greasy for my combo skin. Unless I use a very tiny amount, I cannot wear it during the day or my face starts glistening within hours. I've been using it at night mostly, but because it's such thin and runny consistency, almost like a milky lotion, I don't enjoy it as a night cream either. Will use it up, but will not repurchase.

avis.titre: Helps my skin heal from irritation
avis.texte: This is the moisturizer I use when my skin gets too irritated from using other products. It hydrates but is not heavy or greasy. Def give it a try.
Finally a moisturizer that soaks in non sticky and doesnt peel homy grail i wish i found sooner !!! My new forever product
reading some of these reviews make this moisturizer seem bad but it just proves you need to try it out for yourself. i have acne prone skin and this really calmed down my redness. i love it

avis.titre: I have sensitive skin and this works great!
avis.texte: I've been using the brand Tula for almost two years ago and everyone knows that stuff is great, but its so expensive and in this economy I just cant afford to splurge like that everytime my moisturizer runs out. Ive been eyeing this moistuizer for a while and I finally decided to try it. I didnt come into it expecting it to be better than TULA, but it works great and I honestly have no complains. With Acne prone skin it has not made me break out. My skin feels refreshed and glowy after using this product. I also use it in combo with cliniques hydrating serum.
I love the moisturizer so much! no matter how many other different moisturizers I try, and I always end up going back to Vanicream!

I have been using the First Aid Beauty moisturizer for years but was getting tired of paying up for it - I found this one and nothing else compares for my skin. I have used it all winter with great results. It plays so nicely with makeup and other products. I will repurchase forever!

Yes, the packaging and name are no frills. That's because the product speaks for itself! I have extremely sensitive skin and am allergic to a ton of ingredients often found in skin care and beauty products. Vanicream is gentle and effective. My skin is smooth and hydrated all day.
Dry, sensitive skin. Tried so many times but it always makes me break out the next day and then leaves some weird bumps under skin.
This product feels so good on my skin, it's not thick just right.

Ive spent so much time researching and trying different skin problems as I have hormonal acne. This moisturizer is great for my skin and worked well even when I was on tret. Awesome & simple ingredients and my determatologist said she likes the brand. Like another review said you dont need to spend a lot on moisturizers and cleansers, save that for other products like serums. Will forever repurchase< 3 also I recommend to pair with cerave acne foaming cream wash 10% benzoyl if you also have hornmonal acne!

Ive spent so much time researching and trying different skin problems as I have hormonal acne. This moisturizer is great for my skin and worked well even when I was on tret. Awesome & simple ingredients and my determatologist said she likes the brand. Like another review said you dont need to spend a lot on moisturizers and cleansers, save that for other products like serums. Will forever repurchase< 3 also I recommend to pair with cerave acne foaming cream wash 10% benzoyl if you also have hornmonal acne!
my holy grail moisturizer. its creamy and hydrating but also lightweight and doesn't clog my pores. can't go wrong with this
my holy grail moisturizer. its creamy and hydrating but also lightweight and doesn't clog my pores. can't go wrong with this

I have combo to oily skin and this moisturizor is easy to put on the face and does absorb well. However, i feel like it makes my oily t zone more oily during the day. So when i wear make up, it just slides roght off in that area. I like the benefits that this moisturizor provides, so i use it at night instead.

I started using this facial moisturizer after my dermatologist gave me a sample to try. I have eczema-prone skin and allergies/sensitivities to most products on the market. Due to this, I struggle to find products that I can use without causing a negative reaction to my skin. This is the first line of products that I have been able to use without any problems. Finally! I found a brand of skin products that I can actually use and helps my skin to feel better. Thank you Vanicream! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

I have super dry skin and have been looking for a moisturizer to hydrate and smooth it. This one is perfect! It gives a nice dewy look and is good for morning and night. I wouldn't wear this for a matte look, but if you want glowy, it's great.
this is my 3rd time repurchasing this. It will forever be a staple!

Having sensitive acne prone skin this did not break me out which is a major plus. However it does sting the first second I apply and then goes away, it could also be because I have a damaged skin barrier. Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.
This is the only moisturizer that can control my oily skin. I'm obsessed! I just wish this came in a larger size 😭 Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.
I love how my face feels after putting it on! Great face lotion for combination skin. Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.
Vanicream is the best lotion in the universe!!! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

Vanicream Facial moisturizer is a savior for my face. I love the fact that it sits on my skin perfectly and soaks up pretty quickly, especially on my oily skin, is what I've been searching for in a moisturizer. The added ceramides and no fragrance is just a bonus! I will never be without this moisturizer after my daily wash with Vanicream Gentle Facial Cleanser. Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

avis.titre: The only moisturizer I trust to put on my face!
avis.texte: I've been using this facial moisturizer for years, and I recommend it to everyone I know due to it being lightweight and great for all skin types, but especially sensitive skin. I have eczema around my eyelids and lips but Vanicream does not irritate it. I've tried more expensive moisturizers but they still broke me out. I recommend Vanicream to everyone! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

Hands down the best moisturizer on the market for dry and sensitive skin! So happy I found this product. It has kept my skin nice and hydrated this winter without giving me any issues. 10/10 Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.
This is so awesome for my sensitive skin. I use it daily. I also love the price point. Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

I have sensitive acne prone skin and products usually break me out rather quickly, however using this for days I didn't get that reaction which is really nice! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

avis.titre: Best Skin Moisturizer and My Favorite!
avis.texte: Vanicream's Daily Facial Moisturizer is absolutely my favorite skin moisturizer for my face, neck, etc. If I am going to be in the sun, I will also use Vanicream's Facial Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30 for sunscreen protection. This is the best you can get. Enjoy! Generated as part of the Vanicream Love Your Skin Care Contest.

I have had so many problems with my skin. i have rosacea and very sensitive skin so anything else i would put on my skin it would hate. after trying this moisturizer, I can never go back to anything else. THE BEST MOISTURIZER ON THE MARKET.
This is my favorite moisturizer. I have oily sensitive skin and everything I try normally breaks me out. I put this on damp skin and it's super hydrating.

I've used this for about 4 days straight and today was the last time. It's not moisturizing enough, my skin look dull and dry (and I live in a humid climate) and it burns more and more with each application. Never had a moisturizer sting like this before so I came here to the reviews to see if anyone else had the same problem, or if I'm just crazy. But I see others have said the same. I have no idea what ingredient could be causing this.

I use this moisturizer daily and it was recommended to me by my dermatologist. Its a very light moisurizer so it is perfect for daily use but I do have drier skin in colder months and find myself needing something a little thicker during this time of year. This moisturizer works great under makeup too. I have noticed sometimes it can cause a little burning to my skin every now and when applying after removing makeup and washing but overall a good product.

avis.titre: It is okay, but it clogs my pores
avis.texte: This moisturizer is not the worst, but it makes my skin look more greasy than actually moisturized. It also caused closed comedones on my skin and made my skin bumpy. I used this product for about 6 months, and as soon as I switched from this product, the bumps went away. The product also burned everytime I applied it. It is not the worst but definitely not the best for me. Be careful if you have any sort of sensitive skin!

I am on my second bottle of this. First bottle was 10/10 for my combination, acne-prone skin. This was moisurizing, yet light. Just the level of hydration that I needed. I only wear the Ilia Skin Tint SPF over the top, so I cant say whether or not it pairs well with or pills under makeup. On the second bottle, however, my skin burns the first half hour after I put it on! I will continue to use the rest if this bottle, but I'm uncertain whether or not I will purchase a third.

Ive worked in the cosmetic industry for 7 years and this is my favorite drug store moisturizer that ive found! (And ive tried what feels like everything) I have a lot of problems with my skin, including acne, and this moisturizer doesnt break me out at all.

I have oily skin all year round but sometimes I do get random dry patches on my cheek area however, I used this product for around 3 months or so almost daily and I havent seen one yet! If tou wear makeup I recommend to let this dry down and sink in your skin for a few minutes before applying. It's not amazing but its not bad for a daily moisturizer. I like it alot more when my face is still moist after washing my face.

I am a skincare junkie and a makeup artist. This is a miracle moisturizer! I will spend lots of money on skincare, but this cost effecitive moisturizer is better than most of the expensive ones! The ingredients are amazing and its very hydrating without being heavy. I'm very picky about my moisturizer and I have very sensitive skin, and this has been a lifesaver. Spend the extra money on your serums and active toner, you don't need to spend alot on your moisturizer or cleanser. 10/10 I would recommend!

I have super oily, acne prone, and sensitve skin. It has become significantly worse since coming off the pill. I have tried everything such as adapelene, salicylic acid cleansers, benzoyl peroxide, and other retinols. Even though I used them correctly my sensitive skin was still fried. I used to use the moisturizer from la roshe posay for oily skin, but this stuff is 100x better imo. I was skeptical my first use because this moisturizer does feel very silky like. My skin was recovered in just a few days after using this. Once i switched to a gentle cleanser, byoma milky toner, benzoyl spot treatment, paulas choice exfoliating toner 2x a week, and this moisturer my skin is glowing !! My closed comodones are shrinking too!!

I really wanted to love it, but it pills when used with the Vanicream Vitamin C serum (even after letting the serum soak into the skin for several minutes). It's disappointing that Vanicream products can't be layered effectively.
Lightweight and hydrating. Does not leave a white film, non greasy.

avis.titre: Amazing but don't buy from Ulta
avis.texte: The moisturizer itself is amazing, but ulta doubles the price so I suggest buying it anywhere else!

I would never buy this full price, it's definitely an overpriced product, but I do like it. I thought I'd switch over from CeraVe, one of the only moisturizers my skin is OK with and I think I like the Vanicream a bit better, going to stick with it.

avis.titre: Love it for my very sensitive skin!!
avis.texte: I've tried literally so many face moisturizers, my face is so so sensitive. I've been using this for about 5 months and i absolutely love it. I also use the Vanicream face wash with it twice a day! I definitely recommend trying this product out.
This hasnt made me break out and i have oily skin. Perfect amont of mositure
I'm new to this brand and I'm hooked! My dry, mature face is loving this moisturizer. I haven't tried it in the summer as most moisturizers are to heavy for me in the heat.

avis.titre: Really great on my skin, great ingredients, recycling meh
avis.texte: I wish there was a way to recycle the tube. it's a shame and i think there should definitely be more steps taking to make the tube out of recycled material in the first place and also have recycling options.

For sensitive skin , why do i have a mild burn sensation? It's mild and doesn't last long like 5 minuets after application. don't have sensitive skin ,just have dry skin . I haven't broken out yet but we will see. It is moisturizing.

I had high hopes for this but as soon as i put it on it burned so bad! I was chalking it up to just having had a facial but then i used it the next night and it burned again. Then went back to my usual moisturizer and it didnt burn at all so i had to return.

my skin is a little sensitive and i'm also a tret user for hormonal acne, so it's much more sensitive even than without tret. this stuff is so gentle and has improved my skin barrier after only a couple of weeks. i had no idea what i was missing with vanicream!

I have extremely sensitive skin and this works. My allergist recommended this line to me. Not greasy on the skin and adds that added moisture. Not expensive like other products I have tried and works as well! Try the whole line!

I am beyond thrilled to have tried this. I have acne and super reactive sensitive skin so usually new products dont work out for me. I tried this on a whim bc of how simple the ingridients are. Im almost finished with my first bottle and will repurchase.

I never used a moisturizer, but have had some issues with Rosacea. I tried a few of the doctor prescribed products which did nothing or were even more irritating (and expensive). THEN, once after a very severe flare-up, I was desperate. I remembered a sample tube of Vanicream moisturizer I had stuck in a drawer after attending a health fair and since it contained the word Moisturizer, I ignored it. After remembering I had it, I tried it as a last resort. By then, it was long past expiration date, but was I surprised at how soothing it was. It was my salvation. After a week the Rosacea symptoms had disappeared. I ran to buy a full tube, and to this day I use it daily, rarely have a flare-up and swear by it to friends. Don't ever change the formula.

avis.titre: damaged my skin barrier & closed comedones.
avis.texte: This absolutely destroyed my skin barrier, left my skin itchy and stinging 24/7. Many closed comedones began popping up. Not only did it not moisturize my skin at all, but it left me with contact dermatitis. I know that it is this product for sure because I haven't been using any other products except this one. My skin has never been this dry, itchy, and red.

This is the best moisturizer for my sensitive, acne prone, dehydrated skin. It doesn't break me out and it make my skin seriously soft and happy. It does tingle a bit upon application but it leaves no issues so I'm fine with it!
I've used a lot of moisturizers. I have acne-prone dry skin and this leaves my skin so hydrated after using a small amount. The price you can't beat!

avis.titre: Gave me the worst closed commodes and dried my skin out

I have sensitive combination skin that leans dry and is acne prone (especially hormonal and from irritation). I got this as a summer moisturizer since the regular Vanicream in a tub was too heavy for my summer skin. This one is definitely lighter and absorbs pretty quickly. It didn't really irritate my skin but occasionally I felt a little burn, like if my skin was irritated from retinol. But I wouldn't buy it again. My skin feels dry a few hours after using it, it just didn't hydrate enough even for my sweaty and more oily summer skin, and was just kinda meh.
